author: AnyCantaloupe1659
body: It will never go away, so your best bet is to leave it alone for now and focus on leveling up! As you get stronger, you can start whittling it away. Damage you do persists, so over time you’ll eventually defeat it.

author: myaltaltaltacct
body:
Well, I've taken down three "normal" raid bosses in the past week. One by myself, and the other two I did 2/3 of the damage with one other person contributing. It wasn't a lot of fun, but it got me a bit over two levels (currently 187).

I was REALLY disappointed when I killed the one raid boss solo (which was my first raid); I got a message saying "Raid complete! Here's what you found: 64,588 gold, 661 orns." I couldn't believe I put in all that effort for that reward. Then, 10 seconds later, there was a second notification with 25 million gold, and hundreds of million xp. Totally worth it.

If you really want it gone, add me and I'll come take care of it. :-)

author: Looksees69
body: Chip away, raid bosses aren't assigned "easy" based on your gear rather on their level, e.x. Morrigan will always be brutal difficulty even when you reach 250 and can one shot it.
